Open letter

Okay… this part is dangerously cute. Read slowly.

💌
for Neko — from HaHa

Neko,

A Chinese girl and a Pakistani guy walk into Edinburgh… and instead of it being a joke, it became our life. Somehow, in the chaos of lectures, rainy streets, and “what are we doing with our lives?” energy — we found each other.

We’re from different worlds, different languages of home, different “how do you even cook that?” traditions — and yet you feel familiar in a way I can’t explain. Like my heart recognised you before my brain finished overthinking (rare).

“You pierce my soul. I am half agony, half hope.” — Jane Austen

And honestly… that’s us sometimes. We’ve had days that feel like sunshine, and days that feel like Edinburgh weather: unpredictable, windy, and a bit dramatic. We’ve bumped into each other’s edges. We’ve argued, said sorry, learned the hard way, then learned it again (because we’re stubborn… especially you 😼).

But the happiness you give me outweighs the pain of our fights — and the peace of us, together, is worth every stormy night.

Four years in the UK and I’m still choosing you — not because it’s always easy, but because it’s you. My favourite person. My safest place. My funniest problem. My softest home.

Love you, always — HaHa ❤️ P.S. If you’re smiling right now, I win.
